claim: When a project version is cloned and the same source is rescanned into the clone, determine whether manual BOM edits from the source version are retained.

approval.reason: The test creates a project version, edits BOM data, clones it, and rescans source code in a shared instance.

preconditions: Use only a uniquely named test project and versions owned by this test.
Use a disposable C/C++ source fixture whose scan output is deterministic.
Confirm the test project has capacity under the shared-instance version limit.
Capture the source BOM state and the exact manual edit before cloning.
steps: Create a new test project version and scan the fixture source into it.
Make a documented manual edit to the source version BOM.
Clone the project version and record the clone's initial phase and BOM state.
Rescan the same fixture source and map the scan to the cloned version.
Compare the cloned version BOM after the rescan with the pre-clone manual edit.

expected_result.phase_assertion: If the source version is Archived, the clone defaults to In Development.
expected_result.bom_assertion: Record whether the manual BOM edit is retained, overwritten, or otherwise transformed after rescanning the clone. Documentation does not establish this behavior.

cleanup.plan: After evidence capture, a human explicitly chooses whether to delete or mark test versions LTS, respecting the active-version limit.
